data.body: Recurrence 2026-11-04 PST: make verify on worktree fix-jaeger (commit d413a0497e5, bug bronze-commonable-jaeger, which touches only MCP auth wiring) failed only this test with the same TimeoutError at tests/unit/test_audit_serve.py:292: 1 failed, 20749 passed, 27 skipped, default tier wall 3:01:25 (documented norm 22-26 min). Host load average was 33 on 18 cores right after. Isolated reruns: 5/5 pass on the branch (5.0-7.7 s each) and 3/3 pass on origin/main. Consistent with the load hypothesis in this ticket; not reproduced deterministically here.
